de.title: Azure OpenAI vs. Direkt OpenAI: Kosten, PTU & Einsparungen
de.titleCore: Azure OpenAI vs. Direkt OpenAI: Kosten, PTU & Einsparungen
de.description: Azure OpenAI im Vergleich zur direkten OpenAI API. PTU-Reservierungen (bis zu 82 % Rabatt), regionale Aufschläge, Break-even-Berechnung und Gesamtbetriebskosten.
de.body:
Auf Standard-Pay-as-you-go-Basis kosten Azure OpenAI und die direkte OpenAI API bei globalen Bereitstellungen identisch: beispielsweise $2,50 pro Million Input-Token und $15 pro Million Output-Token für Spitzenmodelle. Der wirtschaftliche Unterschied liegt nicht im Listenpreis für Standardaufrufe, sondern in drei strukturellen Hebeln: Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU), regionalen Datenzonenaufschlägen und Unternehmensrabatten über das Microsoft Enterprise Agreement (EA).

1. Provisioned Throughput (PTU) vs. Token-Abrechnung

Azure bietet dedizierte Modellkapazität über PTUs. Auf Abruf kostet eine PTU $2 pro Stunde. Mit einer 1-monatigen Reservierung sinkt dieser Betrag auf etwa $260 pro PTU und Monat — ein Rabatt von bis zu 82 % gegenüber dem Stundensatz (bei 1-Jahres-Verpflichtungen bis zu 85 %).

Die Break-even-Schwelle für eine PTU-Reservierung liegt typischerweise bei einer durchschnittlichen Auslastung von über 65–75 %. Liegt Ihr Workload darunter oder ist er stark schwankend, ist die tokenbasierte Abrechnung günstiger.

2. Regionale Preisaufschläge

Globale Azure-Bereitstellungen spiegeln die US-Preise von OpenAI wider. Regionale Bereitstellungen (z. B. ausschließlich in Westeuropa oder geschützten Souveränitätszonen) erheben jedoch einen Aufschlag von 10 % bis 20 %. Unternehmen, die Datenresidenz in der EU verlangen, müssen diesen Aufpreis in ihren FinOps-Modellen berücksichtigen.

3. Versteckte Infrastrukturkosten

Bei Azure OpenAI fallen zusätzliche Komponenten an: Private Endpoints, Azure Monitor-Protokollierung, Virtual Network Egress und API Management Gateway-Gebühren. Diese können die effektiven Kosten pro Million Token um 4 % bis 8 % erhöhen, bieten jedoch enterprise-taugliche Sicherheit und RBAC-Zugriffssteuerung.

faq.question: Ist Azure OpenAI günstiger als direktes OpenAI?
faq.answer: Bei Pay-as-you-go sind die Listenpreise für globale Endpunkte identisch. Azure wird durch PTU-Reservierungen bei hoher Auslastung und EA-Rabatte günstiger, regional aber oft 10–20 % teurer.

faq.question: Was ist eine Provisioned Throughput Unit (PTU)?
faq.answer: Eine PTU ist reservierte Modellkapazität bei Azure. Monatliche Reservierungen kosten rund $260/PTU-Monat und bieten bis zu 82 % Ersparnis gegenüber dem On-Demand-Stundensatz.

faq.question: Wann lohnt sich der Wechsel zu Azure OpenAI?
faq.answer: Wenn Sie Microsoft EA-Commitments verrechnen müssen, garantierte Latenz durch PTU bei über 70 % Auslastung erzielen wollen oder strenge Compliance-Vorgaben erfüllen müssen.

ja.title: Azure OpenAI対直接OpenAI費用比較：PTU予約と損益分岐点
ja.titleCore: Azure OpenAI対直接OpenAI費用比較：PTU予約と損益分岐点
ja.description: Azure OpenAIとOpenAI直接APIの料金比較。PTU予約割引（最大82%引）、リージョン別追加料金、損益分岐点の計算、エンタープライズTCOを解説。
ja.body:
グローバル展開の従量課金（Pay-as-you-go）では、Azure OpenAI と直接の OpenAI API は同額です。例えば最新モデルの定価は入力100万トークンあたり2.50ドル、出力15ドルで一致します。両者の真の費用差は基本単価ではなく、PTU（Provisioned Throughput Units）予約、リージョン別データ主権プレミアム、そしてマイクロソフトEA（Enterprise Agreement）割引にあります。

1. PTU予約による大幅な割引

Azure独自のPTU（プロビジョンドスループット）は専用モデル容量を提供します。オンデマンドでは1 PTUあたり1時間2ドルですが、1か月予約を結ぶと月額約260ドルに下がり、最大82%の割引（1年予約では最大85%）となります。

PTUの損益分岐点は、持続的なキャパシティ利用率が約65〜75%以上のワークロードです。利用率が低く夜間や休日にアクセスが途切れる場合は、直接の従量課金トークンの方が安価に収まります。

2. リージョン別追加コスト

グローバルエンドポイントは米国直接価格と一致しますが、日本国内リージョン（東日本）やEUデータゾーンに限定してトラフィックを処理する場合、10%〜20%の地域プレミアムが加算されます。データガバナンス要件とコスト増のトレードオフを計算する必要があります。

3. インフラ付随費用（TCO）

Azure環境ではPrivate Endpoint通信費、Log Analytics、VNetデータ転送料金が加わります。これらは推論費用に4%〜8%上乗せされますが、強固な閉域網セキュリティとActive Directory/RBAC認証が保証されます。

faq.question: Azure OpenAIは直接のOpenAIより安価ですか？
faq.answer: 従量課金の定価は同一です。継続利用率70%超でPTU予約を適用するかEA一括割引を活用すればAzureが安くなりますが、国内固定指定では割高になる場合があります。

faq.question: PTU（プロビジョンドスループット）とは何ですか？
faq.answer: Azureが提供する推論容量の予約モデルです。月次予約で時間単価比最大82%割引となり、急なクォータ枯渇のない予測可能な応答速度を確保できます。

faq.question: 直接OpenAIとAzureのどちらを選ぶべきですか？
faq.answer: Azure残高の消化、日本国内閉域網でのセキュリティ要件、一定以上の高い定常トラフィックがある場合はAzureが推奨されます。

fr.title: Azure OpenAI vs OpenAI Direct : comparatif de coûts et PTU
fr.titleCore: Azure OpenAI vs OpenAI Direct : comparatif de coûts et PTU
fr.description: Comparatif des prix Azure OpenAI et API OpenAI directe. Réservations PTU (jusqu'à 82 % de remise), variations régionales, seuil de rentabilité et TCO.
fr.body:
En tarification standard à l'usage sur les déploiements globaux, Azure OpenAI et l'API directe d'OpenAI affichent des prix catalogues identiques (ex. 2,50 $ par million de jetons en entrée et 15 $ en sortie pour les modèles de pointe). La véritable divergence économique se joue sur trois piliers : les unités de débit provisionné (PTU), les surcoûts de résidence des données régionale et les remises de volume Enterprise Agreement (EA).

1. Unités de débit provisionné (PTU) vs consommation au jeton

Azure propose une réservation de capacité dédiée avec les PTU. À la demande, une PTU coûte 2 $ de l'heure. Avec un engagement mensuel réservé, ce tarif passe à environ 260 $ par mois et par PTU — soit une réduction pouvant atteindre 82 % par rapport au taux horaire (et jusqu'à 85 % sur un an).

Le seuil de rentabilité se situe généralement à un taux d'utilisation continue supérieur à 65–75 %. En dessous, ou pour les trafics imprévisibles, le paiement direct au jeton reste plus avantageux.

2. Surcoûts géographiques et souveraineté

Tandis que les déploiements mondiaux s'alignent sur les prix américains, restreindre vos déploiements aux régions européennes ou souveraines engendre une majoration de 10 % à 20 %. La conformité RGPD stricte et la localité des données ont un impact direct sur la facture FinOps.

3. TCO et coûts cachés de réseau

Déployer sur Azure implique des coûts d'infrastructure annexes : Private Endpoints, stockage des journaux Azure Monitor et sorties réseau VNet. Ces coûts ajoutent 4 % à 8 % au coût effectif par million de jetons, mais procurent une isolation réseau d'entreprise et une gouvernance RBAC intégrée.

faq.question: Azure OpenAI est-il moins cher qu'OpenAI en direct ?
faq.answer: À l'usage standard mondial, les prix sont identiques. Azure devient nettement moins cher grâce aux réservations PTU au-delà de 70 % d'utilisation, mais les régions UE ajoutent 10 à 20 %.

faq.question: Qu'est-ce qu'une unité PTU chez Azure ?
faq.answer: C'est une réservation de capacité d'inférence dédiée garantissant la latence. L'engagement mensuel réduit le coût horaire jusqu'à 82 %.

faq.question: Quand faut-il privilégier Azure OpenAI ?
faq.answer: Privilégiez Azure en cas d'engagements Microsoft Azure consommables, de trafic prévisible justifiant un PTU, ou d'exigences réseau strictes.

es.title: Azure OpenAI vs OpenAI Directo: comparativa de costes y PTU
es.titleCore: Azure OpenAI vs OpenAI Directo: comparativa de costes y PTU
es.description: Comparativa de precios entre Azure OpenAI y la API de OpenAI. Reservas PTU (hasta 82% de descuento), recargos regionales, punto de equilibrio y costes totales.
es.body:
En la modalidad de pago por uso para despliegues globales, Azure OpenAI y la API directa de OpenAI comparten las mismas tarifas de lista (por ejemplo, 2,50 $ por millón de tokens de entrada y 15 $ de salida). La verdadera diferencia en la factura mensual depende de tres factores: las unidades de rendimiento aprovisionado (PTU), los recargos por residencia regional de datos y los acuerdos empresariales de Microsoft (EA).

1. Rendimiento aprovisionado (PTU) frente a tokens bajo demanda

Las PTU de Azure permiten reservar capacidad dedicada de modelo. Bajo demanda, una PTU cuesta 2 $ por hora. Con una reserva mensual, el coste baja a aproximadamente 260 $ por PTU al mes, lo que representa un ahorro de hasta el 82% frente al precio por hora (y hasta un 85% a un año).

El punto de equilibrio para que una reserva PTU resulte más rentable que pagar por token se alcanza con una utilización sostenida superior al 65–75%. Con tráfico esporádico, el pago por token sigue siendo más barato.

2. Recargos por soberanía regional

Los despliegues globales de Azure replican las tarifas estándar de EE. UU. Sin embargo, configurar zonas de datos restringidas a Europa o regiones locales suma un sobrecoste de entre el 10% y el 20% en las llamadas.

3. Costes ocultos de infraestructura (TCO)

Azure OpenAI conlleva gastos auxiliares de red y observabilidad: Private Endpoints, Azure Monitor Log Analytics y transferencia de salida en VNet. Estos añaden entre un 4% y un 8% al coste efectivo de los tokens, pero aportan seguridad perimetral y gobierno corporativo.

faq.question: ¿Es Azure OpenAI más barato que OpenAI directo?
faq.answer: Los precios base por token son iguales. Azure resulta más barato con reservas PTU y uso intensivo (>70%), pero las regiones de datos locales pueden encarecer el servicio un 10-20%.

faq.question: ¿Qué es una PTU (Provisioned Throughput Unit)?
faq.answer: Es capacidad de cómputo reservada en Azure para modelos de IA. Una reserva mensual ahorra hasta un 82% y garantiza latencia estable sin límites de cuota variables.

faq.question: ¿Cuándo conviene elegir Azure OpenAI?
faq.answer: Cuando su empresa disponga de compromisos de gasto con Microsoft, requiera aislamiento en red privada o tenga un volumen predecible para aprovechar PTU.

pt.title: Azure OpenAI vs OpenAI Direto: comparação de custos e PTU
pt.titleCore: Azure OpenAI vs OpenAI Direto: comparação de custos e PTU
pt.description: Comparação de preços entre Azure OpenAI e API OpenAI direta. Reservas PTU (até 82% de desconto), sobretaxas regionais, ponto de equilíbrio e TCO empresarial.
pt.body:
Em consumo sob demanda com roteamento global, Azure OpenAI e OpenAI direta têm preços de tabela rigorosamente iguais (como $2,50 por milhão de tokens de entrada e $15 de saída). A verdadeira diferença econômica está em três alavancas: Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU), sobretaxas de residência de dados regional e descontos corporativos no contrato Microsoft EA.

1. PTU dedicada vs. pagamento por token

A Azure oferece reserva de capacidade via PTUs. Sob demanda, uma PTU custa $2 por hora. Ao fechar uma reserva mensal, o valor cai para cerca de $260 por PTU ao mês — um desconto de até 82% em relação ao custo horário (e até 85% no plano anual).

O ponto de equilíbrio econômico para justificar uma PTU ocorre quando a utilização média sustentada fica acima de 65–75%. Se o tráfego for variável ou sazonal, o pagamento tradicional por token consumido é mais econômico.

2. Variações regionais de preço

Implantações globais seguem a tabela americana da OpenAI. No entanto, restringir chamadas a zonas da União Europeia ou regiões específicas locais adiciona uma sobretaxa de 10% a 20% na fatura de inferência.

3. Custos indiretos de infraestrutura

O ambiente Azure inclui custos de Private Endpoints, exportação para Log Analytics e tráfego de saída VNet. Embora adicionem de 4% a 8% ao custo efetivo, viabilizam controles de acesso corporativo RBAC e isolamento de segurança bancário.

faq.question: A Azure OpenAI é mais barata que a OpenAI direta?
faq.answer: Na tabela básica por token, os valores são idênticos. A Azure torna-se mais econômica com reservas PTU acima de 70% de uso, mas regiões locais podem adicionar 10% a 20% de sobretaxa.

faq.question: O que é uma PTU (Provisioned Throughput Unit)?
faq.answer: É a unidade de capacidade dedicada de inferência na Azure. Oferece latência previsível e economia de até 82% em compromissos mensais ou anuais.

faq.question: Quando migrar para Azure OpenAI?
faq.answer: Quando houver créditos ou metas contratuais de nuvem Microsoft, necessidade de rede privada ou volume contínuo suficiente para amortizar PTU.

it.title: Azure OpenAI vs OpenAI Diretto: confronto costi e unità PTU
it.titleCore: Azure OpenAI vs OpenAI Diretto: confronto costi e unità PTU
it.description: Confronto costi tra Azure OpenAI e API OpenAI diretta. Sconti per prenotazioni PTU (fino all'82%), maggiorazioni regionali, punto di pareggio e TCO aziendale.
it.body:
Nelle distribuzioni globali con tariffazione a consumo (pay-as-you-go), Azure OpenAI e l'API diretta di OpenAI applicano gli stessi identici prezzi di listino (ad esempio $2,50 per milione di token in ingresso e $15 in uscita sui modelli di punta). Le divergenze finanziarie effettive derivano da tre fattori: le Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU), le maggiorazioni regionali per la sovranità dei dati e gli accordi quadro Enterprise Agreement (EA) di Microsoft.

1. Throughput riservato (PTU) vs. consumo a token

Le PTU permettono di acquistare capacità di calcolo dedicata. Su base oraria on-demand, una PTU costa $2 all'ora. Con una prenotazione mensile, il costo scende a circa $260 al mese per PTU — garantendo un risparmio fino all'82% rispetto alla tariffa oraria (e fino all'85% su base annuale).

Il punto di pareggio (break-even) di una prenotazione PTU si colloca tipicamente a un tasso di utilizzo costante superiore al 65–75%. Al di sotto di tale soglia, o in presenza di flussi discontinui, la tariffazione classica a token risulta più vantaggiosa.

2. Sovrapprezzi regionali e requisiti europei

I deployment globali replicano i listini statunitensi. Tuttavia, se l'azienda richiede la residenza dei dati esclusivamente all'interno dell'Unione Europea o in zone protette, Azure applica una maggiorazione compresa tra il 10% e il 20%.

3. Costi infrastrutturali accessori

In ambiente Azure occorre conteggiare anche i Private Endpoint, l'ingestione log in Azure Monitor e il traffico di rete in uscita. Tali elementi incrementano il costo effettivo dei token del 4–8%, compensati però da conformità enterprise e autenticazione IAM granulare.

faq.question: Azure OpenAI costa meno rispetto a OpenAI diretto?
faq.answer: A consumo globale le tariffe sono identiche. Azure diventa sensibilmente più economica con le riserve PTU sopra il 70% di utilizzo, mentre le zone dati UE costano il 10-20% in più.

faq.question: Che cosa sono le PTU in Azure OpenAI?
faq.answer: Sono unità di throughput riservato che garantiscono capacità e latenza stabili, con sconti fino all'82% rispetto alla tariffa oraria se prenotate su base mensile.

faq.question: Quando conviene adottare Azure OpenAI?
faq.answer: Quando si devono consumare impegni contrattuali Microsoft EA, quando serve isolamento su rete privata o quando i volumi giustificano una riserva PTU.

ko.title: Azure OpenAI 대 직접 OpenAI 비용 비교: PTU 예약 및 손익분기점
ko.titleCore: Azure OpenAI 대 직접 OpenAI 비용 비교: PTU 예약 및 손익분기점
ko.description: Azure OpenAI와 OpenAI 직접 API의 비용 비교 가이드. 최대 82% PTU 예약 할인, 리전별 가격 할증, 손익분기점 계산 및 엔터프라이즈 TCO 분석.
ko.body:
글로벌 종량제(Pay-as-you-go) 기준에서 Azure OpenAI와 OpenAI 직접 API의 공시 단가는 정확히 일치합니다(예: GPT 플래그십 모델 기준 입력 100만 토큰당 2.50달러, 출력 15달러). 기업 청구서에서 발생하는 실질적인 비용 차이는 기본 토큰 가격이 아니라 PTU(프로비전된 처리량 단위) 예약, 데이터 주권 리전 할증, 그리고 Microsoft EA(Enterprise Agreement) 약정 할인이라는 세 가지 구조적 요인에서 비롯됩니다.

1. PTU 전용 용량 예약과 종량제 토큰 비교

Azure의 핵심 차별화 요소는 전용 모델 용량을 대여하는 PTU 모델입니다. 온디맨드로 호출 시 PTU당 시간당 2달러이지만, 1개월 약정 예약 시 월 약 260달러 수준으로 인하되어 온디맨드 대비 최대 82%의 비용 절감(1년 약정 시 최대 85%)을 제공합니다.

PTU 예약의 경제적 손익분기점은 24시간 평균 용량 가동률이 약 65~75% 이상 꾸준히 유지될 때 달성됩니다. 야간이나 주말에 트래픽이 급감하는 가변적 워크플로라면 기존 종량제 토큰 결제가 더 경제적입니다.

2. 데이터 주권 및 리전별 할증 요금

글로벌 배포는 미국 OpenAI 본사 가격과 동일하지만, 유럽연합(EU) 내 데이터 보관이나 아시아 태평양 특정 리전을 고정 지정하여 배포할 경우 10%에서 20%의 리전 프리미엄 할증이 청구됩니다. 데이터 규제 준수 요건과 인프라 비용 간의 균형을 검토해야 합니다.

3. 엔터프라이즈 부가 인프라 비용(TCO)

Azure 환경에서는 Private Endpoint 연결 비용, Log Analytics 진단 로깅, VNet 아웃바운드 데이터 전송료가 추가 발생합니다. 이는 실효 토큰 비용을 약 4~8% 증가시키지만, 가상 사설망 격리와 Azure Active Directory 기반 RBAC 보안 통제를 완벽히 충족시킵니다.

faq.question: Azure OpenAI가 직접 OpenAI API보다 저렴한가요?
faq.answer: 글로벌 종량제 가격은 동일합니다. 가동률 70% 이상의 고부하 워크로드에서 PTU 예약을 체결하거나 EA 약정 할인을 적용할 경우 Azure가 훨씬 저렴해집니다.

faq.question: PTU(Provisioned Throughput Unit)란 무엇인가요?
faq.answer: Azure가 제공하는 전용 추론 처리량 단위로, 할당량 초과 없이 일정한 응답 속도를 보장하며 월별 예약 시 최대 82% 할인됩니다.

faq.question: 언제 Azure OpenAI를 선택해야 하나요?
faq.answer: 기존 Microsoft 엔터프라이즈 약정(MACC)을 소진해야 하거나, 폐쇄망 보안 환경이 필수적이거나, PTU 손익분기점을 넘는 대규모 트래픽이 있을 때 적합합니다.

zh.title: Azure OpenAI对比直接OpenAI：成本、PTU与企业TCO
zh.titleCore: Azure OpenAI对比直接OpenAI：成本、PTU与企业TCO
zh.description: Azure OpenAI与OpenAI直接API的全面成本对比。深入解析PTU预留（最高82%折扣）、区域数据主权溢价、盈亏平衡测算与总体拥有成本。
zh.body:
在标准的全球按量付费（Pay-as-you-go）模式下，Azure OpenAI 与直接调用 OpenAI API 的刊例价完全一致（例如旗舰模型输入每百万Token收费2.50美元，输出15美元）。企业账单上的核心经济差异并不在于标准调用单价，而在于三大结构性杠杆：PTU预置吞吐量单元（Provisioned Throughput Units）、区域数据主权溢价以及微软企业协议（EA/MACC）抵扣折扣。

1. PTU专享容量预留对比按量Token

Azure的核心优势在于通过PTU提供独占的模型推理吞吐量。按需调用时单个PTU为每小时2美元；若按月签订预留合约，折合每月约260美元——相较按需单价享受高达82%的折扣（若签订1年期合约折扣高达85%）。

PTU预留的经济盈亏平衡点通常位于全天候平均产能利用率持续高于65%–75%。如果业务负载起伏巨大或夜间无调用，按量计费反而更加划算。

2. 区域数据合规溢价

全局端点价格与美国标准价格对齐，但如果企业要求将数据严格保留在西欧或特定合规主权区域，微软会收取10%至20%的区域溢价。合规成本必须纳入FinOps测算。

3. 隐藏的企业网络与基础设施成本

在Azure中调用模型通常伴随着Private Endpoint私网连接、Log Analytics安全日志和虚拟网络出网流量费。这些外围开销使有效Token成本上浮约4%至8%，但换来了企业级RBAC权限与网络隔离合规。

faq.question: Azure OpenAI是否比直接调用OpenAI更便宜？
faq.answer: 按量计费全球端点价格一致。在业务利用率超过70%并签约PTU预留或通过微软企业协议（EA）抵扣时，Azure成本明显更低。

faq.question: 什么是PTU预置吞吐量单元？
faq.answer: PTU是Azure的独占推理容量单位，提供有保证的延迟和速率，按月签约预留可比按需费用节省高达82%。

faq.question: 企业应该在什么时候选用Azure OpenAI？
faq.answer: 当需要消耗微软MACC云承诺、需要内网隔离合规要求、或具备稳定高并发请求以摊薄PTU成本时。

nl.title: Azure OpenAI vs direct OpenAI: kosten, PTU & break-even
nl.titleCore: Azure OpenAI vs direct OpenAI: kosten, PTU & break-even
nl.description: Vergelijk Azure OpenAI met de directe OpenAI API. Analyse van PTU-reserveringen (tot 82% korting), regionale toeslagen, break-even berekeningen en enterprise TCO.
nl.body:
Op basis van standaard pay-as-you-go zijn Azure OpenAI en de directe OpenAI API voor wereldwijde endpoints identiek geprijsd: bijvoorbeeld $2,50 per miljoen inputtokens en $15 per miljoen outputtokens voor topmodellen. Het financiële verschil zit niet in de standaardeenheidsprijs, maar in drie hefbomen: Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU), regionale datasoevereiniteitstoeslagen en Microsoft Enterprise Agreement (EA) kortingen.

1. PTU-reserveringen versus pay-as-you-go

Azure biedt gereserveerde modelcapaciteit via PTU's. On-demand kost een PTU $2 per uur. Met een maandelijkse reservering daalt dit naar circa $260 per PTU per maand — een korting van tot 82% ten opzichte van het uurtarief (tot 85% bij jaarcontracten).

Het economische break-evenpunt voor een PTU-reservering ligt bij een gemiddelde benutting van 65–75% of hoger. Bij wisselende of lage werkdruk is token-afrekening goedkoper.

2. Regionale opslagen voor datasoevereiniteit

Wereldwijde Azure-implementaties volgen de Amerikaanse OpenAI-tarieven. Wie strikte dataresidentie binnen West-Europa vereist, betaalt echter een opslag van 10% tot 20%.

3. Verborgen infrastructuurkosten

Bij Azure OpenAI komen kosten kijken voor Private Endpoints, Azure Monitor logging en netwerk-egress. Dit verhoogt de effectieve kosten met 4% tot 8%, maar levert enterprise netwerkbeveiliging en RBAC-toegangsbeheer op.

faq.question: Is Azure OpenAI goedkoper dan direct OpenAI?
faq.answer: Voor pay-as-you-go zijn de lijstprijzen gelijk. Azure is aanzienlijk voordeliger bij een continue benutting boven 70% dankzij PTU-kortingen en Microsoft EA-afspraken.

faq.question: Wat is een Provisioned Throughput Unit (PTU)?
faq.answer: Een PTU is gereserveerde capaciteit op Azure die gegarandeerde latency biedt en tot 82% korting geeft bij maandelijkse afname.

faq.question: Wanneer kies je voor Azure OpenAI?
faq.answer: Wanneer u bestaande Microsoft enterprise commitments (MACC) wilt verzilveren, strikte compliancy-eisen hebt of voldoende volume draait voor PTU.

ar.title: مقارنة تكلفة Azure OpenAI مع OpenAI المباشر
ar.titleCore: مقارنة تكلفة Azure OpenAI مع OpenAI المباشر
ar.description: مقارنة تكاليف Azure OpenAI مع واجهة OpenAI المباشرة: حجوزات PTU بخصم يصل إلى 82%، والرسوم الإقليمية، ونقطة التعادل، والتكلفة الإجمالية للملكية.
ar.body:
على أساس الدفع حسب الاستخدام القياسي، تتطابق أسعار Azure OpenAI مع واجهة OpenAI API المباشرة في عمليات النشر العالمية: على سبيل المثال 2.50 دولار لكل مليون رمز إدخال و15 دولاراً لكل مليون رمز إخراج للنماذج المتقدمة. لا يكمن الفارق الاقتصادي في السعر الأساسي للطلبات، بل في ثلاثة محاور هيكلية: وحدات الإنتاجية المخصصة (PTU)، ورسوم مناطق البيانات الإقليمية، وخصومات المؤسسات عبر اتفاقية مايكروسوفت (EA).

1. الإنتاجية المخصصة (PTU) مقابل المحاسبة بالرمز

توفر Azure سعة مخصصة للنماذج عبر وحدات PTU. حسب الطلب تبلغ تكلفة الوحدة دولارين في الساعة. ومع حجز لمدة شهر واحد، تنخفض التكلفة إلى حوالي 260 دولاراً لكل وحدة شهرياً — وهو خصم يصل إلى 82% مقارنة بالسعر بالساعة (ويصل إلى 85% للالتزامات السنوية).

نقطة التعادل لحجز PTU تتطلب عادةً معدل استخدام مستمر يتجاوز 65% إلى 75%. إذا كان حجم العمل أقل من ذلك أو متقطعاً، فإن الفوترة القائمة على الرموز تكون أكثر توفيراً.

2. الرسوم الإقليمية لسيادة البيانات

تعكس نقاط النهاية العالمية لـ Azure أسعار الولايات المتحدة المباشرة. ومع ذلك، تفرض عمليات النشر المحصورة إقليمياً (مثل مراكز بيانات أوروبا أو الخليج) رسوماً إضافية تتراوح بين 10% إلى 20% لضمان إقامة البيانات وسيادتها.

3. تكاليف البنية التحتية الإضافية

تتطلب بيئة Azure مكونات مرافقة: نقاط النهاية الخاصة (Private Endpoints)، وتسجيل Azure Monitor، ونقل البيانات عبر الشبكة الافتراضية، ورسوم بوابة API Management. تضيف هذه المكونات ما بين 4% إلى 8% على التكلفة الفعلية، مقابل توفير أمان متقدم وتحكم في الوصول RBAC.

faq.question: هل Azure OpenAI أرخص من OpenAI المباشر؟
faq.answer: في نظام الدفع حسب الاستخدام تتطابق الأسعار. تصبح Azure أرخص عند استخدام حجوزات PTU مع استخدام يتجاوز 70% أو عبر خصومات اتفاقية المؤسسات EA.

faq.question: ما هي وحدة الإنتاجية المخصصة (PTU)؟
faq.answer: هي سعة استنتاج مخصصة ومحجوزة توفرها Azure. الحجز الشهري يوفر حتى 82% مقارنة بالحساب بالساعة، وتضمن زمن استجابة مستقر دون قيود الحصص المفاجئة.

faq.question: متى تفضل المؤسسات Azure OpenAI؟
faq.answer: عند الحاجة لاستيفاء التزامات اتفاقيات مايكروسوفت EA، وتأمين متطلبات سيادة البيانات في مراكز بيانات محلية، وتحقيق وفورات PTU عند كثافة الاستخدام.

en.title: Azure OpenAI vs Direct OpenAI Cost
en.titleCore: Azure OpenAI vs Direct OpenAI Cost
en.description: Compare Azure OpenAI vs direct OpenAI API pricing. Real 2026 PTU reservation discounts (up to 82%), regional markups, break-even math, and total cost of ownership.
en.body:
Compare Azure OpenAI Services (via Azure's managed API) against direct OpenAI API access. Analyze per-token pricing, provisioned throughput discounts, compliance costs, and total cost of ownership to choose the best path for your workload.

  • Azure Global deployments match direct OpenAI list prices (GPT-5.4: $2.50/$15 on both)
  • Regional and data-zone Azure deployments add roughly 10–20%
  • PTU monthly reservations cost up to 82% less per unit than hourly PTUs
  • Azure adds value for enterprise compliance, regional isolation, and billing consolidation
  • Switching between providers has minimal cost penalty

Per-Token Pricing Comparison

Azure and OpenAI serve the same underlying models, and — contrary to a common assumption — Azure's Global deployment type prices GPT-5.4 identically to OpenAI direct. The premium only appears when you pin traffic to a specific region or data zone, or use extended-context and Pro tiers.

Model / tier OpenAI Direct Input OpenAI Direct Output Azure Input (Global) Azure Output (Global) Difference
GPT-5.4 (standard context) $2.50 $15.00 $2.50 $15.00 parity
GPT-5.4 (>272K context) — — $5.00 $22.50 Azure long-context tier
GPT-5.4 Pro — — $30.00 $180.00 premium tier
GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.6 family $5.00 $30.00 not publicly listed (quote via Azure) —

Regional variation: Azure pricing varies by deployment type, and this is where the real markup lives. Against the Global baseline, Microsoft's published examples include roughly +12% for Regional Australia East and +20% for Regional Sweden Central, with Data Zone deployments around +10%. Exact rates differ per model and region — check the Azure AI Foundry pricing page for yours. If your workload requires a pinned distant region, expect a 10–20% premium over direct OpenAI.

Provisioned Throughput: Where Azure Wins

Azure sells reserved model capacity in PTUs (provisioned throughput units). You pay for capacity, not tokens — so the economics hinge entirely on how fully you use what you reserve. The published rates:

Billing Model Published Rate Vs. hourly PTU Best For
Pay-per-token (either provider) $0 commitment; per-token list prices above — Variable or low volume
PTU, hourly $2 per PTU per hour (≈$1,460/PTU/month if run 24/7) baseline Short bursts, testing PTU sizing
PTU, monthly reservation ~$260 per PTU per month (published GPT-4o Global example) up to −82% Stable, high volume
PTU, yearly reservation quote-based up to −85% Very large, forecastable workloads

How many PTUs do you need? Throughput per PTU is model-specific — Microsoft publishes a capacity calculator in Azure AI Foundry rather than a universal tokens-per-PTU number, and deployments start as small as 1 PTU. That means there is no honest one-line "PTU = X tokens/month" conversion; size it with the calculator against your real traffic.

Modeled example (illustrative arithmetic, not a quote): suppose the calculator says your steady workload needs 50 PTUs. A monthly reservation costs 50 × $260 = $13,000/month fixed, versus 50 × $1,460 ≈ $73,000/month if you ran the same capacity on hourly PTUs. Whether $13,000 beats pay-per-token depends on the token volume those 50 PTUs actually carry — reservations only win at sustained, high utilization.

Cost Comparison: Three Scenarios

Scenario 1: Small Team (100M tokens/month, GPT-5.4)

Volume: 60M input + 40M output = 100M/month total

Direct OpenAI: (60M × $2.50/M) + (40M × $15/M) = $150 + $600 = $750/month

Azure pay-per-token (Global): same list rates → $750/month. A pinned regional deployment at +12–20% would run ~$840–$900.

Azure provisioned: not worth sizing at this volume; even a small reservation is idle most of the time.

Winner: price tie at Global rates — decide on ecosystem, compliance, and quota needs, not price.

Scenario 2: Mid-Size (1B tokens/month, GPT-5.4)

Volume: 600M input + 400M output = 1B/month total

Direct OpenAI: (600M × $2.50/M) + (400M × $15/M) = $1,500 + $6,000 = $7,500/month

Azure pay-per-token (Global): $7,500/month at parity; ~$8,400–$9,000 if you must pin a premium region. (GPT-5.5's Azure rate isn't publicly listed — direct GPT-5.5 for the same volume would be (600M × $5) + (400M × $30) = $15,000.)

Azure provisioned: worth a sizing exercise — if the capacity calculator puts your steady load at ≤25 PTUs, a monthly reservation is 25 × $260 = $6,500, undercutting pay-per-token.

Winner: pay-per-token on either, unless a PTU sizing quote comes in under $7,500 for your throughput.

Scenario 3: Large, Predictable (5B tokens/month, GPT-5.4)

Volume: 3B input + 2B output = 5B/month total

Pay-per-token (either provider, Global parity): (3B × $2.50/M) + (2B × $15/M) = $7,500 + $30,000 = $37,500/month

Azure provisioned (modeled): if this workload sizes to ~50 PTUs, a monthly reservation is 50 × $260 = $13,000/month — a ~$24,500/month saving. If it sizes to ~150 PTUs, the reservation is $39,000 and pay-per-token wins. The PTU count from Azure's capacity calculator IS the decision.

Winner: Azure provisioned when usage is stable and the sized PTU cost lands well below $37,500. Risk: if volume halves, the reservation cost doesn't.

Non-Price Factors: When Azure Wins

Factor OpenAI Direct Azure OpenAI Impact on Cost
Compliance (FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2) No official certification FedRAMP High, HIPAA, SOC 2 available Compliance add-on not needed; built-in
Data residency US-based Multiple regions including EU, UK, Asia Can avoid GDPR penalties if storing in EU
Unified billing Separate invoice Consolidated Azure bill Simplifies chargeback to teams (small savings)
Role-based access control API key only Azure RBAC (granular per-team or per-resource) Reduces shadow spend / untracked usage
Quota management Hard rate limits; 429 errors Provisioned throughput reserves capacity Avoids request rejections at peak load

Cost of switching: Minimal. Both use the same OpenAI API shape (models, parameters, endpoints). Migration is mostly DNS/config change. No ETL, no retooling. You can test Azure in parallel before committing.

Decision Matrix

Use Direct OpenAI if:

  • Your volume is <1B tokens/month
  • Your workload is variable (unpredictable spikes)
  • You don't have compliance requirements beyond standard SOC 2
  • You need models whose Azure rates aren't publicly listed (GPT-5.5/5.6 family)
  • You're not on Azure or don't need consolidated billing

Use Azure OpenAI (pay-per-token) if:

  • You're already paying for Azure services and want one bill
  • You need FedRAMP/HIPAA/compliance features
  • You want RBAC and quota management over API keys
  • You operate in EU and need data residency (regional deployments cost ~10–20% more)
  • Global deployment works for you — it matches direct OpenAI list prices

Use Azure OpenAI (provisioned) if:

  • Your volume is high, stable, and forecastable 3–6 months ahead
  • You need guaranteed quota (no rate-limit rejections)
  • Azure's capacity calculator sizes your workload to a PTU count whose reservation cost (~$260/PTU/month) lands clearly below your pay-per-token bill
  • You can justify the reservation commitment if volume dips

Cost Optimization Tips

Monitor quarterly: Review your actual token volume vs. forecast. If actual volume is <80% of forecast for 2 consecutive months, consider downgrading your provisioned tier or switching to pay-per-token.

Use Azure Advisor: Automatically recommends right-sizing for provisioned throughput. Frees up reserved capacity you're not using.

Batch off-peak requests: If using provisioned throughput, batch non-urgent requests during off-peak hours to smooth volume spikes and keep TPM steady.

Layer by model cost: Route classification and extraction tasks to a budget tier (e.g., GPT-5.6 Luna at $1/M input, $6/M output direct) and reserve GPT-5.5 for reasoning. Reduces effective cost-per-token.

Split between providers: High-volume stable workloads on Azure provisioned; variable/bursty on Direct OpenAI. Costs might be lower than picking one provider for everything.

Switching Strategy

Test in parallel (2 weeks): Deploy your app with Azure OpenAI alongside Direct OpenAI. Route 10% of traffic to Azure, 90% to Direct. Monitor latency, error rates, and cost difference.

Gradual migration (4 weeks): Once confident, shift 50% traffic to your chosen provider over 2 weeks, then 100%.

Keep fallback (ongoing): Maintain keys for both providers. If one has an outage or quota issue, gracefully failover to the other (will see a small cost impact but better than downtime).

faq.question: Is Azure OpenAI cheaper than direct OpenAI?
faq.answer: At standard rates, neither: Azure Global deployments price GPT-5.4 at the same $2.50/M input and $15/M output as OpenAI direct. Regional and data-zone Azure deployments add roughly 10–20%. Azure's advantage is compliance, RBAC, quota management, and consolidated billing — not per-token price.

faq.question: What is provisioned throughput?
faq.answer: Azure's reserved model capacity, billed per PTU (provisioned throughput unit): $2 per PTU per hour on demand, or about $260 per PTU per month with a monthly reservation — up to 82% less than the hourly rate (yearly reservations reach up to 85%). Throughput per PTU is model-specific; size it with Azure's capacity calculator.

faq.question: When should I use Azure OpenAI?
faq.answer: Use Azure if: (1) you're already on Azure and want consolidated billing, (2) you need compliance/FedRAMP/sovereign-cloud guarantees, (3) your throughput is high and steady enough that a PTU reservation beats pay-per-token for your workload.

faq.question: Can I optimize cost by switching between Azure and direct?
faq.answer: Yes, if your usage is variable. Use pay-per-token for low or unpredictable volume; consider PTU reservations only for sustained, forecastable throughput. Monitor quarterly and switch if the cost difference exceeds 10%.
